precedence: LP202.2 runtime inventory/hydration state and owner

semanticStateModel.AVAILABLE_WITH_CROSSINGS: ACTIVE_POSITIVE plus successfully hydrated active-county-owned inventory and a nonzero awareness-area count
semanticStateModel.AVAILABLE_NO_GOVERNED_CROSSINGS: ACTIVE_EMPTY plus successfully hydrated active-county-owned intentional zero inventory
semanticStateModel.AVAILABLE_NO_LOCAL_CROSSINGS: ACTIVE_POSITIVE plus successfully hydrated active-county-owned inventory and zero awareness-area crossings
semanticStateModel.LOADING: governed county exists and its active-county inventory is not yet successfully hydrated, without failure
semanticStateModel.TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE: governed county exists but source resolution or hydration failed
semanticStateModel.UNAVAILABLE: no governed county Crossing source exists

bannerPrecedence.before: A stale legacy crossing flag replaced healthy quiet community copy with Limited local coverage.
bannerPrecedence.after: All healthy available states preserve normal awareness-first quiet/active copy; only actual temporary or unsupported failure may supply coverage warning copy.

liberty.after: AVAILABLE_WITH_CROSSINGS even when legacy value is forced missing
